tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Shimʿon, from the root sh-m-ʿ, 'to hear' — 'he has heard'. Its root is Hebrew sh-m-ʿ. Simon Peter; Simon the Zealot. Simon is a Hebrew name meaning “He has heard”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
